info.desc: Morning Phase is Beck's ninth official studio album. It was nominated for five awards at the 57th Annual Grammy Awards, winning three: Album of the Year, Best Engineered Album, Non-Classical and Best Rock Album. .

podcast.body: This album, Beck's twelfth studio effort, won the Album of the Year Grammy in 2015 when he was 44 years old. It had a "modest hit" chart performance, opening at number three on the Billboard 200 in early 2014 but then tumbling off the chart entirely by the following February when he won the Grammy. Unlike Bonnie Raitt's "Nick of Time," this win was not as celebrated, partly due to the "Beyoncé factor" and the perception that he was a "default choice" as the "token rock nominee" among other popular artists. His albums did not chart better after this big Grammy win, and it's "doubtful Beck won many new fans on morning phase." "Morning phase was the 12th studio album by Beck, issued as he just turned 44."
